target_customer: Aspiring data scientists and ML engineers who pay mentors a share of first year salary
problem: Learners struggle to land data science jobs without guidance; SharpestMinds matched them with experienced practitioners paid through income share agreements.
business_model: Income share agreement: percentage of first year salary after hiring, shared with mentors

founders.name: Edouard Harris
founders.background_notes: Stayed on the board after stepping back in 2021.

founders.name: Jeremie Harris
founders.background_notes: Arizona State University faculty page calls him former co-founder; no other background read.

technical_complexity.rationale: Matching and payments platform with contracts; the hard part is operational, not technical.

defensibility.rationale: Mentor community helps, but mentorship and ISA bootcamps were easy to copy.

market_need_then: Demand for data science careers was high in 2018; YC page cites mentors from Apple, Uber, Tesla, Facebook and Amazon AI groups.

identity.voice_and_tone: Tagline: peer to peer mentorships through income share agreements

branding.community_and_virality: Company leaders describe a supportive mentor and mentee community in a July 2021 post.

brand_strength.rationale: Meaningful name and an active community, but no independent press about the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: SharpestMinds stayed small: it raised about 120 thousand dollars (YC) and in July 2021 the founders handed leadership to Russell Pollari and Alejandro Ruperti to work on AI safety, after discussions about shutting down or selling. It kept operating, so the YC inactive flag may reflect a later closure that is not documented; no cause is public.
notes: sharpestminds.com returned HTTP 503. The seed rests on one database (CB Insights, March 2018; Seedtable says January 2018). One search summary says YC marks it acquired but the YC page shows inactive; no acquirer is documented. Competitor search found no dated 2018 sources, so the list is empty. Outcome: status conflict between YC (inactive) and a 2021 post (operating); cause of inactivity is not public.
